acceptance_rule: A benchmark is accepted only when its stated test was actually executed and the result is reproducible. Passing unit tests, a green model-arithmetic audit or a screenshot do not establish that the professional workflow was independently validated.

benchmarks.name: Equity Research
benchmarks.objective: SEC data to three-statement model, reverse DCF, comparables and scenario view.

benchmarks.adversarial_cases: Curve inversion, negative rates, distressed spread, day-count mismatch.
benchmarks.evidence_available: Curve and bond pricing primitives exist in `atlas/institutional/service.py`; coverage is incomplete rather than absent.
benchmarks.missing_implementation: Published-vector parity, derivative breadth, stress engine and day-count edge cases.
